description: This file contains utility functions related to OAuth configuration, including generating redirect URIs and constructing authorization URLs for GitHub OAuth within a React web application.

methods.name: getRedirectUriForAuthCallback({ preferProvider } = {})
methods.description: Computes the redirect URI for OAuth or email flow callbacks, prioritizing provider-specific URLs, then site URL, and falling back to the window location origin.

methods.name: getGitHubOAuthConfig()
methods.description: Returns GitHub OAuth client ID and redirect URI, sourcing from environment variables, global app config, or by invoking other utility functions.

methods.name: buildGitHubAuthorizeUrl({ clientId, redirectUri, scope = 'read:user user:email', state })
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for initiating GitHub OAuth authorization with specified client ID, redirect URI, scope, and optional state parameter.

ctags.name: buildGitHubAuthorizeUrl
ctags.pattern: /^export function buildGitHubAuthorizeUrl({ clientId, redirectUri, scope = 'read:user user:email',/
